result.summary:
Rework iteration 1 of 3 on docs/agents/design/REQ-027.md, addressing the one MAJOR and two MINOR findings in handoffs/WF02-REQ-027/step-01b-design-validator.json. Everything else in the design (the cancelEvent scope-boundary claim, AC4's structural registrations-untouched argument, Sec2's WHERE-clause exclusion matching AC1's 5-notification arithmetic, the full AC1-AC5 map in Sec7, and open questions 1-3 in Sec8) was verified correct by the validator's own independent re-check and was not touched.

MAJOR (Sec3, notifyNonWithdrawnRegistrants rule point 2): the fenced sendLedgeredNotification({...}) call -- a concrete object literal with an inline arrow function for composeMessage -- was replaced with prose introducing a field/source table: db from the function's own db parameter; sender from its own sender parameter; registrationId from candidate.registrationId; kind as the literal string "event_cancelled"; classification as the literal string "transactional"; userId from candidate.userId; composeMessage described as 'a function of lang that calls composeCancellationMessage with db, candidate.registrationId, the eventTitle parameter of notifyNonWithdrawnRegistrants, and that lang' -- no call expression, no arrow-function syntax, no object literal remains. Field sourcing is unchanged from the failed version; only the syntax changed from an executable call to a description, matching REQ-026's own rework precedent (commit 65704b4) for the same violation class.

MINOR (Sec5, handler-wiring paragraph): the literal before/after index.ts lines (bot.command("event_cancel", makeEventCancelHandler(db)); becoming ...makeEventCancelHandler(db, notificationSender));) were replaced with a prose sentence: 'index.ts's existing bot.command("event_cancel", ...) registration, which currently constructs makeEventCancelHandler with only db, is updated to construct it with the process-wide notificationSender as a second argument' -- same fact (one added constructor argument, same reused sender instance, no new configuration), stated without quoting executable code.

MINOR (Sec8, open questions): added a 4th open question naming the synchronous-batch-blocks-the-single-threaded-long-poll-loop risk precisely as the validator described it (apps/bot/src/index.ts:195 bot.start() with no @grammyjs/runner concurrent dispatcher; notifyNonWithdrawnRegistrants awaited before the handler's own ctx.reply; delay bounded by rateLimiter.ts's ~N/25s pacing but otherwise unbounded in N; no repo-local PRD volume figures found to bound N). Recorded my own judgment explicitly rather than leaving it silent: accept this as a known Release-1 limitation, not a blocker -- no AC exercises event scale, PRD 1's 'do not add infrastructure' stance rules out introducing a concurrent runner or job queue for this one call site, and fire-and-forget dispatch would weaken AC1's 'notifications sent' guarantee (no way to surface a failure of a detached call back to the organizer) for no proven volume benefit at Release-1's expected chapter sizes. Named a future requirement (bounded-concurrency send or a real background job) as the correct place to revisit this if real usage later shows the delay is actually reached.

No other line in docs/agents/design/REQ-027.md was changed; this is a surgical three-spot fix (one MAJOR rewrite, one MINOR rewrite, one MINOR addition).
